vault.title: 🔐 Vault
vault.create_warning: ⚠️ WARNING — Encryption is irreversible. If all members lose access to the key, the minutes will be PERMANENTLY UNREADABLE, even for an administrator. Keep a PDF export of important minutes outside the application before enabling the vault.

vault.create_bureau_only: Only board members (president, vice-president, secretary) can create the vault.
vault.unlock_error_hint: The password is incorrect but your data is not lost. Try again or contact another board member who can re-invite you.

vault.title_hint: Use neutral titles to protect sensitive information (e.g. 'Section 1 – Findings'). Titles remain visible in cleartext.
vault.minutes_locked: The vault is locked. Unlock it to view and edit encrypted minute content.
vault.minutes_locked_preview: The vault is locked. Unlock it before generating the PDF export — encrypted data is not readable without the key.

archive.title: Minutes archive
archive.subtitle: Delegation minutes library — content stays encrypted (vault) and only displays after unlocking.

vault.recovery_forgot: Forgot password? → Use my recovery key
vault.recovery_not_configured: No recovery key configured — ask the board to generate one.
vault.recovery_error: Invalid recovery key — check the characters you typed.

vault.recovery_new_password_short: The new password must be at least 6 characters.
vault.recovery_password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
vault.recovery_created_warning: ⚠️ Print it or store it somewhere safe (password manager, physical safe). If you lose it AND forget the password, encrypted minutes will be permanently lost.
vault.recovery_created_never_again: This key will never be shown again: the server does not store it.
vault.recovery_manager_desc: If the password is forgotten, the recovery key unlocks the vault and lets you set a new one — without losing any minutes.
vault.recovery_revoke_confirm: Revoke the recovery key? Members will no longer be able to use it to unlock the vault.
vault.recovery_replaced: Recovery key replaced (the old one no longer works)
